title: Concept: TLS certificate verification bypassed in rust — review required
description: In rust, the client is configured to accept invalid certificates. TLS without peer validation protects only against passive observers; an on-path attacker can present their own certificate and read or modify the traffic. The option is usually added to reach a staging host with a self-signed certificate and then ships.
applicability: rust services and CLIs that call HTTPS endpoints.
risk: Traffic interception and response tampering; HIGH severity.
